purpose: Falsify extrapolation of actual trained P7/MLP memory selection and previously learned native archive states on shifted action-consequence laws; synthetic DEV only

training.training_source: original unchanged P7 public factual synthetic_dev and P3 40-old/40-reversed

transfer.actions_distribution: uniform with NumPy Generator integer sample; same actions every arm
transfer.current_target_visibility: none until every arm routes and predicts; then all history-based arms observe only that executed action consequence
transfer.history: last 8 completed factual action/outcome pairs, identical across trained P7 and trained MLP and ridge; trained policies default to old archive with <8 samples

ridge_control.description: conventional intercept plus action effect regression using same past eight factual pairs; no labels or latent regime

transfer.native: step80 trained model with cold-restored step40 vs step80 native fast memories; step80 recurrent/history held fixed; zero new optimizer or fast-memory writes

negative_controls: future current observation not present in route call
same factual past and action for all nonoracle arms
oracle evaluated separately as privileged ceiling
caveats: These are newly authored synthetic DEV constitutive laws, not independently born sealed scientific worlds.

The original native model was trained on discrete ±1 actions, so it may not produce useful predictions at unseen action magnitudes even with oracle memory; competence must be checked before crediting routing.
A different causal law cannot be inferred without enough previously observed real outcomes; this measures only familiar task-sign retrieval on a shifted action-to-consequence map.
LearnedRouter and conventional MLP train on original public P7 data with equal steps and minibatches but no matched total FLOPs or independently verified convergence.
Online ridge is an information-matched conventional adaptive controller, but not a matched-update trained baseline; do not claim superiority without fully trained conventional controls.
No new scientific first-use, real-world transfer, accepted model promotion, live owner trainer, scheduler, FORGE integration, new runner or independent research mutations.
